home.h1: Cur rud er bun gys dy chéile
home.lede: Cur lhiggey dy gníomh ta cur ayns feme da'n neb, da'n traa as da ny ta ayd. Obbyryn yeeasht, obbyr paitchyn, nithyn dy dhéanamh gys dy chéile as smooinaghtyn cruthanagh shiaghtagh, lesh ny ver-yn aasey as cart dy chur dy phrintey. Stad cha minnick ta eh jeh dy chooilley ouyl.

home.gamesTitle: Gammanyn nod oo cloie nish hene
home.gamesLede: Ta dagh fer kiune, ayns aght dooiney aasit, as aashagh dy ghoaill toshiaght er. Reih fer jeu, soie lhiattee rish lhiattee, as gow shiu keayrt bentyn rish y scaailan.

steps.title: Reih red ennagh cadjin
steps.text: Caslyssyn jeh cappanyn tee, gareyn, kynsheelogheyn as baatyn-shiaull. Gyn lhaih ny reillyn dy ynsaghey hoshiaght.

steps.title: Soie lhiattee rish lhiattee
steps.text: Lhig daue bwoalley er y scaailan. Loayr mychione ny caslyssyn. My nagh vel ad co-reggyrtagh, cha nel eh agh fuirraghtyn rish y nah vowal.

steps.title: Scuirr choud's t'eh maynrey
steps.text: Ta un ghamman ny jannooys slane. Ta “Jeant son nish” er y scaailan kinjagh.

home.stageTitle: Eieyn son jannooyssyn ec dagh ceim
home.stageLede: Kiaull, obbraghyn laaoil, aachooineaghtyn as tullaghnyn kiuney rieughid, er nyn gooieaghey rish ny ta aashagh nish.

stages.title: Y chied cheim
stages.text: Gleash lesh ny t'ad cur taitnys ayn, lesh caghlaaghyn beggey: cheirdyn taitnys, jurnaghyn beggey, gammanyn fockle as plannal ry-cheilley.
stages.label: Eieyn y chied cheim

stages.title: Y vean-cheim
stages.text: Obbraghyn aashagh, cadjin er nyn mranney ayns keimyn: fillley, sortaghey, kiaull, gammanyn caslyssyn as shooylyn giare.
stages.label: Eieyn y vean-cheim

stages.title: Y cheim s'anmey
stages.text: Aash as kiangley trooid bentyn, feam as reayrt: kiarail laueyn, arraneyn share, caslyssyn as ve ry-cheilley.
stages.label: Eieyn y cheim s'anmey

home.specificHtml: Ta oo lheih rud sonnin? Feer gníomhyn as geamyn son Alzheimer, tarrinyn as geamyn bwoallagh, geamyn checcaght ya tarrinyn.
home.approachTitle: Gníomh dy chloaghey, cha nel traoightey
home.approachLede: Ta mooarane "geamyn inney" currit mychione luaths, sooillyn as ronsaghyn sooillyn. Son neb ta traisht, sheebagh ny ta beaghey lesh dementia, shegin shoh cur er y chied dy ghoaill ny lheid oc ec traoightey. Ta shin er cur nyn gníomh ayns y chooid jeh yn kiare.
home.approachLink: Cre'n fa ta shin kiaddey myr shoh

principles.title: Cha nel nhee erbee dy choayl
principles.text: Gyn ooryddyr, poyntyn, bea ny coayl. Cha nel caslys elley agh aash, cha nel eh ny vod.

principles.title: Caslyssyn ta tannaghtyn er fakin
principles.text: Enney harrish aachooineaghtyn. Ta co-reggyrtys goaill toshiaght er nyn oaie, myr shen cha nel red erbee dy chooiney er.

principles.title: Freill arrym as aght aasit
principles.text: Focklyn meigh, aashagh as caslyssyn jeh'n theihll firrinagh. Ny jean ymmyd jeh caslyssyn aitt ny glare lhiannoo rieau.

principles.title: Preevaadjagh rere kiaddey
principles.text: Gyn coontyssyn ny soilsheenyn. Cha nel dty chaslyssyn faagail dty ghreie rieau.

guides.title: Kys dy chloie gammanyn ry-cheilley
guides.text: Aght aarloo, bieauid, as cre dy yannoo tra nagh vel gamman taitnyssagh ny sodjey.

guides.title: Tra t'ad gobbal jannooys
guides.text: Oyrryn cadjin son gobbal, as aghtyn meigh dy phrowal reesht ny s'anmey.

guides.title: Gníomhyn ard gys dy chéile
guides.text: Raadyn dy chéile son boayl jeh dy hoi dooinney, as obbyr son dy chooilley dooinney.

guides.title: 101 smooinaghtyn gníomhyn
guides.text: Smooinaghtyn aasey, rheynt rere ny ta ayd as cre mooar nane ta ayns y traa shoh.

home.researchTitle: Slaynt yn inçhyn: ny ta'n ronsaght gra dy firrinagh
home.researchText: Nod dementia ve er ny lhiettal? Vel gammanyn inçhyn cooney? Cre mychione trostey, bee, cadley as clashtyn? Freagyrtyn aashagh er bun feanish, goaill stiagh raad nagh vel y feanish lajer.
home.appTitle: Creative Activities er iPhone, iPad as Android
home.appText: Ta'n app seyr shoh gobbraghey magh ass moggyl as foddys eh jannoo ymmyd jeh caslyssyn lught-thie t'ou hene er reih, freilt myr coipyn er dty ghreie. Yn un chiaddey kiune: kiare leacyn mooarey, gyn traa, gyn poyntyn.

faq.q: Ta ny geamyn mie son daoine aaghey?
faq.a: Ta geamyn mie aasey, currit mychione as cha nel ayns cur er ny sheeayl: ard-dealbhyn mooar son cur ayns eaghtyn, rheynt, tarrinyn aasey, cur ayns ny fockleyn currit dy ghoaill ec mo ta er ny hoiggal, dathey, bingo dealbhyn as cairtyn checcaght. Ta ad mie son mooarane daoine aaghey, as shen ny ta beaghey lesh dementia. Ta'n roght mie y reayll ta'n dooinney kiune jeh lhiam ayns y laa shoh. Cur as-y-moo tuittyn, sooillyn as rudyn ta lhig dhooys dy row eh ny traoightey.

Ta. Ta dagh cloie as duillag-chlou er Creative Activities nastee, gyn coontys, recortys ny laadey neose erbee. Ta ny cloiaghyn roie ayns y jeeagheyder-moggey er çhellvane, claare-screeuyn ny co-earrooder.

Cha nel geam currit dy beagh dementia er ny lhiggey, as cha vel Creative Activities currit dy traailt ny lhiggey rud erbee. Ta ny geamyn dooin son gaaghtyn as aggle gys dy chéile, as cha vel shiaght gníomhyn cur coontey mychione yn slane.

faq.q: Vel ny cloiaghyn shoh cooie da peiagh as çhingys Alzheimer orroo?
faq.a: Ta. She çhingys Alzheimer y chooish s’cadjiney jeh shaghrynys-inntin, as ta ny cloiaghyn jeant er e hon: caslyssyn mooarey ta tannaghtyn ry-akin, beggan reihyn, as veg dy chooinaghtyn ny dy yannoo marran. Ta piyral, sorçhaghey as cur jerrey er shenn-raaghyn cadjin bwoalley er fys shenndeeagh ayns ynnyd jeh ynsaghey noa.

faq.q: Nod peiagh as shaghrynys-inntin anmagh orroo jannoo ymmyd jeh ny jantyssyn shoh?
faq.a: Dy mennick, foddee, lesh peiagh ennagh rish nyn gooish. Ghow toshiaght lesh Feddyn y fer cheddin lesh daa chaslys, Piyryn caslys lesh kiare teelan, duillag ghaaghey ny fea tayrn ennal kiune. Jean eh giare, eiyr orroosyn, as scurr tra t’ad er n’ghoaill nyn saie.

Cha nel coontyssyn ny soilshaghey-fysseree erbee er yn ynnyd-eggey shoh. Ta shin jannoo ymmyd jeh Google Analytics dy hoiggal cre ny duillagyn ta goll er jeeaghyn orroo. Cha nel fotografyn ta shiu reih son Piyryn fotograf ry-akin agh ayns y jeeagheyder-moggey eu hene, as cha nel ad rieau goll er laadey seose.

Ta Creative Activities buird beg dy lhiam shiaghtagh ta cur gníomhyn cruthanagh son daoine aaghey ayns y chooid jeh cha dooin ta cur aayn er son neb, er y lheayr as ayns ayrn saor. Cha nel shin er ny clinicyn, as cha nel çhamliys mychione slane ayns shoh.

Loayr rish fer-lhee roish caghlaa bee, roortys, cadley, lheeys ny bishaneryn. Son boiraneys dooraghtagh ny caghlaaghyn dooraghtagh elley, fow cooney lhee chelleeragh. Lhaih nyn vaghtys oayllys slaynt.

about.bodyHtml:
Son cre ta shoh?

Pob dooinney ta cooinaght son persoon: ayr, shenn-ayr, paarlid, pardjee, cooinaght ya dooinney ta beaghey gys dementia. Ta ayrnyn, shenn-ayrnyn, obbyryn un-aasagh as obbyr-yerrey as ny duillagyn shoh ny-ynnyd son ny h-uileyn.

Cre ta shin credjal

Ta cur-sheese y ghaghtyn ayns y traa hene: cleaysh, gaire, y yeeish dy chur daa dealbh cheayrt, ny shiggey cadjin er-yn-oo. Cha nel eh dy vesheil dooinney, dy chur ad nish ny dy thaishtey rud erbee.

Ta ny h-aplikaysyn brain-training ny inney er nyn ghoaill ec clagh, scoran, sreamyn as ny ynnyd. Son dooinney ta shassoo, nee neuvoaidh ny ta beaghey gys dementia, shen ta eh coayl mooar sy vakkagh cadjin nagh vel toiggal ayns. Ta shin er nyn ghoaill dy chooid, as ta shin cur oor fein gys ny reayllyn shoh:

  • Cha nel rud erbee dy ghoaill ayns lhiggey. Cha nel clock, scoran, counter-ynnyd, beaghyn, sreamyn, confetti ny cooishtyn-jeeragh, er nyn scrymmyn.
  • Aitheantys sy chur-rish ayns reih. Ta dealbhyn currit er-lheh tra t'ad rish ny cooin. Ta leshtyn cur cooin ayns cleaysh as cha bee ceisht er ennymyn ny cooinaghtyn.
  • Mooar, soilshee as cooyl. Screeuyn as dealbhyn mooar, dorraghys mooar, as smooinaghtyn ta er-lheh ayns y ynnyd cheddin.
  • Ashoonys dooinney aasagh. Dealbhyn jeh saogheil as cleaysh soilshee, cairdyssagh. Cha nel cartoonyn, moladh cheayrt shingey ny reayrt emoji.
  • Ard-ynnyd ayns cosh. “Ta shin jeant nish” hie dy cheet ry-akin. Stoo ayns y meann ta toiggal mie.
  • Pryvit er-lheh. Cha nel accoontyn na reclamyn. Dealbhyn t'ou dy chooilleeyn ta ec dty ynnyd-ynnyd.

Cre cha nel shin cur er

Ta nyn gaghtyn as cluichyn son sollagh as cheayrtys. Cha nel ad diagnoseys, dy hassey, dy vesheil, dy hoilley, dy lhiggey dy chur er dementia ny Alzheimer’s disease, as cha bee neb ec ny jerree ad er y chied ny. Tra ta shin screeuey mychione taggloo slaynt, ta shin gra dy cheet cre ta'n fianys lag, as cha nel shin dy cheangley eh rish nyn gaghtyn fein.

Cre t'ayns shin

Ta Creative Activities ny ghooinney beg neu-cheangallagh. Cha nel shin ny dochtyryn. Ta nyn lhargyn screeuit veih reamyn foillishit liorish cooishyn such as the National Institute on Aging as the Alzheimer’s Association, as ta pob lhargey lhisteyn nyn foayrn. Lhiggey ny shegooin ta shin screeuey as jeeaghyn ny duillagyn nyn.

Inneen dooys cre ta cooperaght

Vod shin cur-my-fo dy chlashtyn cre ta obbraghey son oo as cre nagh vel, fo-reayrt veih ny dooinney ta beaghey gys dementia, cooinaghtyn ayns y ghooinney as obbyr-gaghtyn ny gaghtyn. Cur post gys {email}.

editorial.title: Kys Ta Shin Screeu as Scrutaghey Ny Duillagyn Ain
editorial.description: Cre'n-fa Creative Activities ny ynnydee screeuys, ny reamyn, ny foayrn as ny duillagyn slaynt ayns ny gaghtyn, as cre cha vee shin dy cheet dy chur magh byth.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

faq.title: Feyshtyn as Ansooryn
faq.seoTitle: Ceistyn as Freagarthyn Mychione Creative Activities
faq.description: Freagarthyn son ceistyn cumtey mychione y chluichyn as gaghtyn: cre'n-fa dy hayrn, cre hene dy chluich, buinnyn as ideeyn son staagyn foast, slaynt as pryvaseyn.
faq.lede: Ansooryn giare, aashagh da ny feyshtyn s’mennick ta kiarailee feyshtey.

items.q: Cre ny cluichyn ny mie son shenn-ayrnyn?
items.a: Ta ny gammanyn share cliaghtit, aashagh as gyn broo erbee, as she yn fer kiart cre erbee t’ad goaill taitnys ass jiu. Ta cur caslyssyn ry-cheilley lesh caslyssyn ta ry-akin, sortaghey, jigsaws aashagh, cur jerrey er raaghyn cliaghtit, daaghey as bingo caslyssyn gobbragh dy mie da ram sleih. Shaghnee earrooderyn-traa, poyntyn as red erbee ta gollrish scrutaght.

items.q: Vel ny gammanyn nastee dy jarroo?
items.a: Ta. Ta dagh cloie as stoo ry-chlou nastee, gyn coontys, recortys, laadey neose ny soilsheenyn.

items.q: Cre’n fa nagh vel poyntyn, keimyn ny ooraderyn ayn?
items.a: Ta bieauid as poyntyn caghlaa obbyr thaitnyssagh dys prowaltys, as foddee shen cur nearey ny corree er peiagh. Ta shin freayll y toshiaght er taitnys as traa ry-cheilley, myr shen cha nel red erbee ry-choayl as foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee.

items.q: Cre ny jeshaghtyn ta gobbraghey share?
items.a: Gagh laue-fonn, taiblet ny co-earrooder lesh jeeagheyder-wweb noa-emshyragh. Ta taiblet er staik ec boayrd ny saase s'aashagh dy mennick da daa pheiagh dy chloie lhiattee ry lhiattee. Ta co-earrooder glioon kianglt rish çhellveeishan gobbraghey dy mie da possanyn.

items.q: Nod mayd cloie lesh caslyssyn-shoilshey lught-thie ain hene?
items.a: Nod. Ta Photo pairs caghlaa eddyr 2 as 6 caslyssyn-shoilshey ta shiu reih dys cloie co-reggyrtys. Ta ny caslyssyn-shoilshey tannaghtyn ayns dty yeeagheyder-wweb as cha nel ad goll er laadey seose ny sauail.

items.q: Cre cho foddey lhisagh jannooaght tannaghtyn?
items.a: Dy mennick, ta 10 dys 20 minnidyn dy liooar, as ny keayrtyn ta 2 vinnid ny ventyr mie. Cur-my-ner cowraghyn scaaghey ny corree, as scuirr choud’s t’eh foast thaitnyssagh. Cha nel mooadys kiart ayn.

items.q: Cre my nagh vel ad laccal jannoo jannooaght?
items.a: Cur arrym da’n obbal, as prow reesht ny s’anmey ny er aght elley. Foddee obbal çheet rere scaaghey, pioys, gyn ve shickyr, ny gyn foys erbee y ve oc. Jeeagh er nyn stiurey er cre dy yannoo tra t’ad gra nagh vel.

items.q: Cre ny jannooaghyn ta cooie da keimyn s’anmey jeh dementia?
items.a: Aash as ny biallyn: geaishtagh rish kiaull share, masoal laue lesh smerragh, jeeaghyn er caslyssyn-shoilshey ry-cheilley, cummal brolley bog, soie mooie ’syn aer, ny cloie caslys feer aashagh marish peiagh ennagh lhiattee roo. Ta ram eieyn elley ayns nyn stiurey er keimyn s’anmey.

items.q: Vel jannooaghyn ayn da possanyn ayns thie-kiarail?
items.a: Ta. Ta caartyn ry-chlou as eamerey er y scaailan ec Picture bingo, as ta Finish the saying as Conversation cards gobbraghey dy mie tra t’ad lhaiht magh. Ta nyn stiurey da possanyn ayns thieyn-kiarail goaill stiagh mooadys y phossan, soieaghey, as caghlaa son kiedyn mestit.

items.q: Nod cloieyn lhiettal ny moalaghey dementia?
items.a: Cha nel cloie erbee er hennaghtyn dy lhiettal dementia, as cha nel nyn gloieyn gra lheid y red. Ta greesaghey inçhynagh ayns çhymbyllaght sheshoil er soilshaghey vondeishyn beggey ayns ronsaghey da sleih as dementia meen dys meen-vlassagh orroo, agh t’eh shen feer anchasley rish cloie ta lhiettal çhingys. Ta shin çhebbal cloieyn son taitnys as caadjys.

Cha nod, lesh shickyrys. Ta ronsaghey kiangley 14 bun-chooishyn slaynt as saase-veaghee rish gaue dementia, lheid as coayl clashtyn, ard-vroo foalley, neu-ghleashaght chorpagh, as lomarcanys sheshoil. Foddee lhaih orroo leodaghey y gaue da paart dy leih, agh ta ram sleih ta jannoo dagh red dy kiart foast feddyn dementia. Cha nel eh aggair da peiagh erbee rieau.

items.q: Vel trostey shallidagh mie son slaynt yn inçhyn?
items.a: Ta feanish ayns sleih veg as leah, as ta ram jeh’n ronsaghey ayns baaghyn. Foddee trostey ve gaueagh da sleih shinney, er-lheh marish stoo-lheeys çhingys shugyr ny coayl trimmid gyn ynsagh, as cha nel eh kiedit da sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia. Loayr rish fer-lhee roish my vel shiu caghlaa nyn saase-eeanlee.

Gyn coontyssyn ny soilsheenyn. Ta shin gymmydey Google Analytics dy earroo keayrtyn as dy akin cre ny duillagyn ta cooney, as ta dty yeeagheyder-wweb cooinaghtyn my vel shiu er chur sheeanyn boggey er. Cha nel ny caslyssyn-shoilshey ta shiu reih son Photo pairs goll er laadey seose rieau. Jeeagh er y fogrey preevaadjys son ny smoo fysseree.
Cha nel. Ta Creative Activities son aash-ghoail as fysseree chadjin. Son feyshtyn slaynt, loayr rish fer-lhee, as son emerjinsyn cuir fys er 999.

handout.description: Duillag ry-chlou un-ghuillag da lught-thie as arreydee mychione cloieyn caslys meen as nastee da sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia, son possanyn-coonee as packadyn-kiarail.

handout.introHtml: Caslyssyn mooarey, focklyn aashagh as veg ry-choayl. Nastee er laue-fonn, taiblet ny co-earrooder, gyn recortys, gyn soilsheenyn, gyn ooraderyn as gyn poyntyn. Soie-jee lhiattee ry lhiattee as gow-jee keayrtyn.

Chammah er y ynnyd-eggey

  • Stoo nastee ry-chlou: ronsaghey fockle lesh clou mooar, duillagyn daahmee, caartyn coloayrtys as picture bingo.

print.grid: Ta lhiassag ec dy chooilley scoill. Gow yn lhiassag shoh ayns y key, as dathagh y scoill lesh peccyr jeh'n dath shen. Ta dath elley ec yn ynnyd cooilleagh neesh. Cha nel arragh dy hie gys shooyl.
print.colors: Ta dath ayns dy chooilley reaghey. Smooinaght da dooinney ta jeh'n dath shen, ny cur cearkle mygeayrt lesh pen. Ta shoh ry-chionnagh coorse noa.
print.dice: Ta dy chooilley reaghey ny sleih jiarg. Gow reaghey, ny cur y lhiassyn ayns y fer as tar ny stoylley lesh ayns ny fir-oik cooilley, as abbyr shen mygeayrt ny chooilley ren. Gura mie da ny dooinney dy jean ny doon.
print.words: Cur yn fockyn mygeayrt, ny cur linn voish dy chooilley fockey gys y lhiassag. Lhiam yn fockyn cheet ny yiow rish dy chooilley ec aght.
print.cards: Cur yn cardyn mygeayrt ec y lhiassyn dashed. Cur ad er lhimmey ayns y bwoard, as gow yn cuirrey.
print.chain: Ayns pappeyr, lhiam yn lhiassyn veih lesh gys y reaghey, ny hene ny harrish y chooilley. Dy chooilley person, abbyr shen aon fockey mychione ny lhiassyn my vees, as smooinaght da'n lhiassag elley. Gura mie da ny dooinney dy jean ny doon.
print.sort: Cur yn lhiassyn mygeayrt ec y lhiassyn dashed, as cur dy chooilley aon ayns y vaase ta currit ayns.
print.puzzle: Cur yn lhiassag mooar mygeayrt ec y lhiassyn dashed ayns ceithar pieces as cur ad rere ny ghoaill. Oddagh dy ayns daa pieces ec yn un eh, tra vees y lhiassag slane. Ta'n lhiassag beg ayns yn ynnyd kiaull.
print.cutSafety: Foddee cooinaghtyn ny yiow chreau er y cheshyn roish oo toshiaght. Cur y screabyn shaghey dy yeeaghyn er.

reasons.photos: Cha vel dooinney pappeyr ayns shoh. Ta'n geam shoh ry-chliah dy ghoaill ny grainnaghyn ayd ayd eh hene, ta ad ayns dty browser as cha vel ad ry-yeeaghyn riu, shen dy vod y site ny clo ad. Dy ghoaill er pappeyr, clo daa lhiassyn jeh ny grainnaghyn ry-harragh ayns dty hie as lhaih ad ec y bwoard.
reasons.paced: Cha vel dooinney pappeyr ayns shoh. Ta'n cearkle cur-dy-hoi jeh cur-dy-shiaull ayns y screen, as cha vod pappeyr clo shen, shen dy vel shen ny ynnyd elley. Ta pause quiet er-dy-chooilleyn lesh cheayrt gyn screen cheu.
reasons.turns: Cha vel dooinney pappeyr ayns shoh geam. Dy yeeaghyn paarrey ec y bwoard, clo cardyn lhiassag veih Picture pairs as gow dy chooilley sheshey ny cardyn y chur er y chuill.
reasons.screen: There is no paper version. This is a picture to look at together on a screen; a favorite photo or postcard on the table does the same.
reasons.wash: Ta cha n-aon ghlare ann ayns paipyr. Ta peintyr-uisge er paipyr corrym y chied red: scuirr fliuck, as dy hennag jiu ec un vea dy vooar.
reasons.sayings: Ta cha n-aon ghlare ann ayns paipyr fo-dhegooish. Er paipyr, veign dy jeeaghyn ny crooidyn oll, as va'n chied ceum mooar "Jeeagh er y chrooid" gyn cheshaght. Lhig dooin ny raaghyn y leeaghyn er y screen cha-ghlooiney, ya dy vod shen ny roaiagh cuid jeh's erbee ta shiu oc.
